notes.title: Developer Livestream and AMA
notes.content:
Rainbow Laser Disco Dungeon is part twin stick-shooter, part rhythm game, part dungeon crawler, where every action is locked the rhythm of the music.

Demo is live. Watch it or play it yourself. Or BOTH!

notes.content: It is what it says it is. Watch me play my own game like a big nerd. Ask me anything!
